The '''Kaski system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[Kaski throwing blade]]s were produced in this system.
